title: It's Gravel Time!!!
description: Did you ever think gravel was useless? Me neither! So here's some filters and other stuff to make your gravel lifestyle fully understandable!
body:
In this mod, there's a bunch of stuff to use to make gravel finally useful!

So let's start...

-First, there's filters, that you can craft to extract the good stuff from gravel.

With the filters and some gravel, you get pebbles, that you can craft into pure gravel, that also gives ore shards when brocken with a shovel.

-There's also new blocks called "Pure Gravel Bricks" that takes their colors from the nearby water, and every variant you want is here.

Finally, this mod is completely vanilla friendly, so don't worry, no mods are a problem, and neither is needed!
